words.gloss: in the assembly of the ignorant
in the assembly of the wise

literal: In the assembly of the ignorant, even by forgetfulness, do not speak, those who speak well so as to be received in the assembly of the wise.
translation: Those who are capable of speaking in a wise assembly so that their words are well received should not, even by forgetfulness, speak in an assembly of the ignorant.
modern: அறிவுடையோர் கூடியிருக்கும் நல்ல அவையில், கேட்பவர் மனதில் பதியும்படி நன்றாகப் பேச வல்லவர்கள், அறிவில்லாதவர்களின் புல்லவையில் மறந்தும் பேசக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet advises skilled speakers on where to avoid speaking. Those who possess the rare talent of speaking effectively in an assembly of wise and noble people (நல்லவை) should never speak in an assembly of the ignorant or low-minded (புல்லவை), even by a slip of the mind or forgetfulness (பொச்சாந்தும்). The word 'சல' (often read as 'செல') means 'to go into' or 'to be received/understood' by the audience. Speaking to an audience that cannot appreciate or comprehend wisdom is futile and diminishes the speaker's value.
